instruments.notes: Min/max WTI price arrangement; settled against average NYMEX WTI closing price. Quote found in production_text (instrument_text is truncated before it).
instruments.evidence_quote:
arrangements which fix a minimum West Texas Intermediate ("WTI") price per
barrel of $18.00 and a maximum WTI price of $21.30 for 4,000 barrels of oil
production per day for the period January 1, 1997 through June 30, 1997

instruments.notes: Fixed average WTI price; gain/loss = contract price minus average NYMEX WTI close. Type 'swap' inferred from the settlement description. Quote found in production_text.
instruments.evidence_quote:
arrangements which fix an average WTI price of $23.47 for 3,000 barrels of oil
production per day for the period January 1, 1997 through March 31, 1997

instruments.notes: Hedged at average price; gain/loss = contract price minus average settlement price for last three days of the month. Type 'swap' inferred from settlement description. Quote found in production_text.
instruments.evidence_quote:
Company also has 15,000 Mmbtu per day of natural gas production hedged for the
months January through March 1997, at an average price of $3.07 per Mmbtu.

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: Company enters, and expects to continue to enter, oil and gas hedging transactions to stabilize cash flow for capital planning; tied to production, not speculative.
